stories.title: Netanyahu klaagt media en journalisten aan om artikelen waarschuwing 7 oktober

en.title: Netanyahu sues media and journalists over articles warning of October 7
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu filed a defamation lawsuit against several major Israeli news media outlets and journalists, with the newspaper Haaretz as the primary target.

stories.title: Netanyahu klaagt media aan die berichtten over waarschuwingen voor 7 oktober

en.title: Netanyahu sues media outlets that reported on warnings before October 7
en.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu filed defamation suits against three media companies and six journalists after reports emerged that he had received personal warnings about the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack but did not share them with security officials.

stories.title: Twee vrachtwagenchauffeurs overleden bij ongeluk N48, weg tot de ochtend dicht

en.title: Two truck drivers killed in N48 accident, road closed until morning
en.summary: Two truck drivers died in a multi-vehicle collision on the N48 near Zuidwolde involving three trucks and three cars. The road was closed until the following morning due to debris from one of the vehicles.

stories.title: Geen explosieven gevonden bij Britse militaire basis RAF Fairford, Amerikaanse minister Rubio ziet ‘duidelijke betrokkenheid buitenlandse partij’

en.title: No explosives found at British RAF Fairford military base, US Secretary Rubio sees 'clear involvement of foreign party'
en.summary: Five British individuals were released on bail after behaving suspiciously near RAF Fairford military base on Sunday, with their vehicles thoroughly searched. No explosives were discovered during the investigation.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri wordt de eerste vrouwelijke premier van Marokko

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes Morocco's first female prime minister
en.summary: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, the mayor of Marrakech, has been appointed as Morocco's new prime minister and will form a government during a period of significant political unrest.

stories.title: Burgemeester Halsema vroeg rapper Ye in brief direct na concert te vertrekken

en.title: Mayor Halsema asked rapper Ye to leave Amsterdam directly after concert in letter
en.summary: Amsterdam's mayor sent rapper Ye a personal letter in June requesting his immediate departure from the city after his final concert, citing her responsibility to maintain moral and societal boundaries.

stories.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri wordt eerste vrouwelijke premier van Marokko

en.title: Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri becomes first female prime minister of Morocco
en.summary: The royal palace announced that Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri has been appointed as Morocco's new prime minister, marking the first time a woman holds this position.

stories.title: De bezuinigingen op WW en WIA zijn van tafel, maar de wens om te hervormen nog zeker niet

en.title: Cuts to unemployment and disability benefits are off the table, but the desire to reform remains
en.summary: Proposed budget cuts to unemployment and disability benefit programs have been withdrawn, though efforts to restructure these systems continue.

stories.title: Voor één begroting is nu steun gevonden. Daarmee zijn de kabinetsperikelen nog niet van tafel

en.title: One budget has found support, but cabinet disputes remain unresolved
en.summary: The Dutch cabinet reached a deal on the Social Affairs and Employment ministry budget by scrapping all cuts, though funding for this remains unclear and consensus on other issues like box 3 taxation has not been achieved.

stories.title: Met El Mansouri krijgt Marokko voor het eerst een vrouwelijke premier

en.title: Morocco gets its first female prime minister with El Mansouri
en.summary: King Mohammed VI appointed Fatima-Zahra El Mansouri, a prominent member of the winning PAM party, as prime minister following last week's parliamentary elections. She is Morocco's first female premier and previously served as housing minister and mayor of Marrakech.

stories.title: Bewoners Negen Straatjes willen met rechtszaak einde maken aan TikTok-rijen: ‘Alles in onze buurt draait om Fabel Friet’

en.title: Residents of Negen Straatjes want to end TikTok crowds with lawsuit: 'Everything in our neighborhood revolves around Fabel Friet'
en.summary: Residents of the Negen Straatjes neighborhood are considering legal action to address crowds of TikTok users gathering in their area related to a popular local establishment.

stories.title: Eerste verbod lijkt te werken: minder mensen met te veel chemicaliën in bloed

en.title: First ban appears to be working: fewer people with excessive chemicals in blood
en.summary: Nearly three-quarters of Dutch people have elevated PFAS chemical levels in their blood, down from near-universal prevalence previously. Despite improvements, many still have dangerously high PFAS concentrations.
